recommendation: Lead care management for medication-assisted treatment in primary care
implementation_steps: Conduct comprehensive patient assessments for substance use disorders
Coordinate with prescribers on medication-assisted treatment plans
Monitor treatment adherence and response through regular follow-up
Provide ongoing support and education to patients and families
Facilitate connections to additional behavioral health services as needed
evidence_summary: Nurse care manager-led interventions for medication-assisted treatment in primary care settings have demonstrated significant improvements in treatment retention, adherence, and outcomes for patients with opioid use disorders.
